identified_as: Ridley Township High School, Folsom (Ridley Twp.)
era: Ridley Township HS (building finished 1934) is the direct predecessor of Ridley High School; the 'Green Raiders' name dates back at least to 1954.
notes: Green confirmed by the school's own 1954 nickname; white inferred from the continuing Ridley colours.
evidence: 1954 Ridley Township HS yearbook (e-yearbook OCR, pp.32-33) calls the football team the 'Green Raiders'; green and white continues at successor Ridley HS. No colour artwork from the old school seen, so no hex. Retry: full 1954 OCR searched again (school paper also named 'Green Raider'; colourguard, cheerleaders) but no colour statement; white still inferred.

identified_as: Mastery Charter School Lenfest Campus, Philadelphia
notes: Mascot Pumas per Mastery athletics page; some Lenfest teams play in the 'Mastery Charter South co-op [Lenfest/Thomas] Bulldog' co-op. No campus colours found; Mastery network site colours (#005DAA etc.) are not campus colours.
evidence: Mastery athletics page lists 'Lenfest Campus Pumas'; Lenfest campus page lists PIAA sports incl. wrestling but no colours or campus logo; MaxPreps Lenfest page blocked (403). Retry: sitecolors on Lenfest campus page gives only network brand colours and Mastery network logos; MaxPreps not reachable (403 / host not allowed); search snippet shows Shoemaker Pumas (a different campus) as royal blue and white, not used.

identified_as: Sewickley Township High School, Herminie (Westmoreland Co.)
era: Sewickley Township HS (Herminie; classes from 1923) became Sewickley Area High School by the 1960s, later part of Yough (Cougars; green and orange). Do not use Yough's colours.
notes: Herminie identity now supported (pa-roots class lists 1924/1933 'Sewickley Township High School, Herminie'; 1966 Herminie yearbook counts Sewickley graduates from 1923). Colours still not found.
evidence: pa-roots class-of-1924/1933 pages (no colours); 1966 Sewickley Area HS (Herminie) yearbook full OCR searched for colour words, alma mater, nickname: nothing usable. Web searches found only Yough.

era: Elizabeth High School (Elizabeth borough) still existed under that name in 1952 (its first yearbook, 'Eli-Mon'); later merged into Elizabeth Forward (Warriors; red and black). Colours here are from Elizabeth HS's own 1952 book.
notes: Nickname Warriors already in use in 1952 (cheer 'W-A-R-R-I-O-R-S', school paper 'Warrior'). Colours from garbled OCR of the cheerleader page; white may be uniform base only. Yearbook's own 'blue and white' is the book's design colours, not the school's.
evidence: 1952 Eli-Mon (first yearbook of Elizabeth High School, e-yearbook OCR): cheerleader page says uniforms 'were the white ... big red E' and spells the 'W-A-R-R-I-O-R-S' cheer; staff page says the yearbook's colours will be blue and white. Scans not viewed in colour, so no hex.

identified_as: Lake-Noxen Joint High School, Harveys Lake (Luzerne County)
era: Predecessor of Lake-Lehman (formed by later merger).
notes: Blue and white is Noxen High's colour per its alma mater; adopted by Lake-Noxen only by inference. Yearbook name 'Chieftain' hints at the nickname (unconfirmed).
evidence: Lake Noxen Joint HS 'Chieftain' yearbook 1954 (e-yearbook OCR) prints both predecessor alma maters; the Noxen High one says 'Flag we love blue and white'. No statement of the joint school's own colours found in the 1954/56/57 books. Retry: full OCR of 1954/1956/1957 searched for colour words, nicknames and uniforms; the Laketon alma mater names no colour, and 1956 mentions only gold basketball awards and a blue-and-silver dance tree.

identified_as: Captain Jack Joint High School, Mount Union (Huntingdon Co.)
era: Captain Jack Joint HS (Mount Union) already used the Trojans name in 1955 (school paper 'Trojan'); presumably the predecessor of Mount Union Area (Trojans; royal blue and Vegas gold), but its own colours are unconfirmed.
notes: Nickname Trojans confirmed from the school's own 1955 yearbook; colours still not found.
evidence: 1955 Ilium yearbook full OCR (e-yearbook): baseball write-up calls the team 'the Trojans', school paper is 'The Trojan'; no colour words, alma mater or uniform description found.

era: Ralpho Township is now served by Southern Columbia Area (Tigers; black and gold).
notes: Not the successor Southern Columbia's black and gold.
evidence: Ralpho Township HS 1951 yearbook is titled 'Blue and Gold' and its alma mater (e-yearbook OCR) ends 'To you our Alma Mater, Good old Gold and Blue'. Scans are black-and-white. Retry: no further sources tried; colour names stand on the school's own yearbook title and alma mater.

identified_as: Mahanoy Joint High School, Herndon/Dalmatia (Northumberland County)
era: Herndon-area joint school (yearbook 'The Bruin'); later part of Line Mountain School District, not Mahanoy Area.
notes: First pass identity (Mahanoy City area) was wrong. Nickname probably Bruins (from yearbook title, unconfirmed). Successor identification (Line Mountain) is from geography, not a source read.
evidence: Lykens Valley history site: 1962 football team photo captioned 'Mahanoy Joint High School, Herndon (Dalmatia), Northumberland County', from the 1963 yearbook 'The Bruin'. No colours stated; photo is black-and-white. Retry: search found more Lykens Valley team photos (1952 baseball, 1955 girls basketball, 1962 baseball) but the site refused direct fetches (406), so not opened; no e-yearbook listing for 'The Bruin'. No colours.

identified_as: West Mifflin North High School, West Mifflin
era: West Mifflin North HS (Commonwealth Ave., opened 1960; WPIAL Class AA football champion 1963) merged with West Mifflin South in 1984-85 into West Mifflin Area HS (Titans; blue and gold) in the North building. Do not give North the Titans' colours without a source.
notes: Identity confirmed. North's own nickname and colours not found; no North yearbook on e-yearbook.
evidence: TribLive 2013 article on North's 1963 WPIAL title (merger 1984-85; no colours); Wikipedia raw history; 1986 West Mifflin Area 'Titan' yearbook (first merged years: 'Blue and Gold Week', no North history) and South 'Sohian' 1967/1979 OCR (North named only as opponent). No colours for North.
